notes: ModelEffect_Construct: on a garbage block every byte after the vtables (colour 1,1,1,1; the base fields). Both tables compared. Reached through Create (0xc06c00, hooked). Mutants: 20 of 20 killed over the class (see Create)

name: cTSModelEffect::~cTSModelEffect
notes: ModelEffect_Slots: the model, the node and the owner released, in the original's order, through the +4 deleting slot; the log compared

name: cTSModelEffect::`vftable thunk +4 deleting'

name: cTSModelEffect::`scalar deleting destructor'
notes: ModelEffect_Slots: flags 0 and the last Release (flags 1): frees by size, through the +4 face

name: cTSModelEffect::Attach
notes: ModelEffect_Primitives (500 cases per side: cube, sphere, cone, axes, other names, cached names, _cres names with the model service faked) and ModelEffect_Slots. Slot 0; the SetModel path and the primitive path (AddPrimitive). The primitive shapes (0xaef310 axes marker, 0xaef5b0 box, 0xaf05b0 sphere, 0xaef950 cone) and the material handle (0xc05be0 id, 0xae8820 bind, 0xae8870 release) are geometry and material code, still original. ORIGINAL-BUG x2: the key is made by Sprintf with the 24-byte std::string passed by value, and the cache lookup is by name while inserts are by key, so it never hits in real play. Mutants: 20 of 20 killed over the class

name: cTSModelEffect::SetModel
notes: ModelEffect_Slots (the model service faked): slot 14; the key parsed, the model manager asked of the service, Load, release. Result the Load's. ORIGINAL-BUG: a service giving no manager is dereferenced (the original too); not exercised

name: cTSModelEffect::HandleEvent
notes: ModelEffect_Slots: slot 7; kind 3 sets the alpha from the description's float and the first factor, kind 4 the three colour words from the vector and factors 0..2; other kinds false; then the tint cleared (all four near 1) or applied through the tree. Mutants killed: kind compares, factor order and slots, the near-1 test, the layer name

name: cTSModelEffect::SetFlagged
notes: ModelEffect_Slots: slot 9, flag 10 of every renderable node under the effect's node

name: cTSModelEffect::Detach
notes: ModelEffect_Slots: slot 1, the node and the model dropped

name: cTSModelEffect::Create
notes: ModelEffect_Slots builds through it on each side: 400 seeds x 40 steps. Operator new (nothrow), then the constructor; null on failure (the failing allocation is not tested). Hooked; every object the game makes carries our vtables, so the constructor, destructor, Attach, Detach, HandleEvent, SetFlagged and SetModel are in effect through it. Called by cTSModelDescription::CreateEffect. Mutants: 20 of 20 killed (the slots' branches and arguments, the primitive arguments, the cache lookup, the _cres test)

name: cTSModelEffect::SetColour
notes: The layer "ShapeColor" and the colour attribute 0x8c798726 on every renderable node under the tree; the colour a cVector4fEvent. Our static helper inside cTSModelEffect.cpp, tested through HandleEvent and Attach in ModelEffect_Slots (the node fake logs every call)

name: cTSModelEffect::ClearColour
notes: The layer taken off every renderable node under the tree. Static helper; tested through HandleEvent in ModelEffect_Slots (layer name mutant killed)

name: cTSModelEffect::SetFlagTree
notes: Flag 10 set on every renderable node under the tree. Static helper; tested through SetFlagged in ModelEffect_Slots
